name: m3-03-fiscal-facilities
title: Article 166 lets Jakarta grant Aceh tax and customs relief on request; no PMK or PP has ever done so.
sourceLine: Source: UU 11/2006 Art 166; Dialeksis, revision article list; Informasi Publik, Jun 2026. Note: the no-instrument finding rests on one source. [1142][1108][1109]
